note: sdc_tags (submodule of cl_editorial) defines the component_tag plugin type (YAML discovery of MODULE.component_tags.yml, manager plugin.manager.sdc_tags.component_tag, alter hook component_tag_info, default class ComponentTagDefault). Tagging rules live in the sdc_tags.settings config object under component_tags.<tag_id> = {tag_id, statuses[], allowed[], forbidden[]}; the admin UI is /admin/config/user-interface/sdc/component-tagging (+ /auto/{tag}). No configure info.yml key, no permissions of its own, no Drush. Medium cases write a known rule to sdc_tags.settings and read it back; hard cases require the agent to write a real tagging rule (allow-list vs forbid) verified against that config. All tag keys are namespaced sdct_* and only that key is touched.

evals.prompt: Using the sdc_tags module, how do I declare a new component tag called 'hero' so that Single Directory Components can be tagged with it? Which file and what shape?
evals.expected_output: Add a MODULE.component_tags.yml (or THEME.component_tags.yml) file with a top-level key per tag, e.g. `hero:\n  label: 'Hero components'\n  description: '...'`. The ComponentTagPluginManager discovers it as a component_tag plugin; rebuild caches and it appears on the tagging admin page.

evals.prompt: Where does sdc_tags store the tagging rules (allowed/forbidden components and statuses) for each tag, and what is the config structure?
evals.expected_output: In the sdc_tags.settings config object under component_tags.<tag_id> = {tag_id, statuses[], allowed[], forbidden[]}. You can also fetch a tag's resolved rule with sdc_tags_get_tag_filters($tag_name).

evals.prompt: What plugin type does sdc_tags define, and which service is its plugin manager?
evals.expected_output: It defines the component_tag plugin type. The manager is the plugin.manager.sdc_tags.component_tag service (Drupal\sdc_tags\ComponentTagPluginManager), using YAML discovery of *.component_tags.yml, default class ComponentTagDefault, alter hook component_tag_info.

evals.prompt: On this site, sdc_tags has a tagging rule configured for a tag named 'sdct_known'. Inspect the live sdc_tags configuration and name the specific SDC component that this tag explicitly allow-lists.
The sdc_tags tag 'sdct_status' on this site restricts which component lifecycle statuses are permitted. Inspect the live configuration and state which status(es) it allows.

Using the sdc_tags module on this site, configure a tagging rule for the tag 'sdct_task' that allow-lists only the cl_editorial:component-card component and permits the 'stable' status. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set sdc_tags.settings component_tags.sdct_task to {tag_id: sdct_task, statuses: ['stable'], allowed: ['cl_editorial:component-card'], forbidden: []} and save (e.g. via configFactory()->getEditable('sdc_tags.settings')->set('component_tags.sdct_task', [...])->save()).

evals.prompt: Configure the sdc_tags tag 'sdct_forbid' so that it applies to all stable components EXCEPT cl_editorial:component-card (i.e. use the forbidden list, keep the allow-list empty, permit the stable status). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set sdc_tags.settings component_tags.sdct_forbid to {tag_id: sdct_forbid, statuses: ['stable'], allowed: [], forbidden: ['cl_editorial:component-card']} and save. Empty allowed + a forbidden entry means 'all stable components except the forbidden ones'.
